item.title: Israel is 'systematically dismantling Palestinian life' says human rights group
item.description: One of the country's leading human rights organizations says Israel is dismantling all aspects of Palestinian life at a breakneck rate. The group has extensively documented what it says are the mechanisms Israel has used to "ethnically cleanse" the West Bank of Palestinians.
item.content:encoded: One of the country's leading human rights organizations says Israel is dismantling all aspects of Palestinian life at a breakneck rate. The group has extensively documented what it says are the mechanisms Israel has used to "ethnically cleanse" the West Bank of Palestinians.

item.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
item.description: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.

item.title: Talks between Iran and Gulf states to discuss Strait of Hormuz postponed
item.description: Iranian officials say a meeting with Gulf states to discuss the Strait of Hormuz has been postponed, dealing a blow to efforts to reopen the strait.

item.title: Indonesia searches for 129 people missing after ferry capsizes in the Java Sea
item.description: Indonesian authorities intensified on Monday a search for people missing after a ferry overturned in bad weather in the Java Sea. At least six passengers were killed and 129 people are still missing.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after dignitaries passed through
item.description: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.

item.title: Can Gulf states and Iran negotiate the Strait of Hormuz without the U.S.?
item.description: Dania Thafer of the Gulf International Forum weighs in on previously scheduled talks between Iran and Gulf states. Shortly before this interview aired, Oman announced that the talks were postponed.
